|rulings=* During initiation of this Interrupt, a player chooses a weapon to fire, not a target to fire at. Opponent's response (such as [[Sense (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Sense]]) is played before the target to fire at is chosen. A response to the weapon targeting (e.g. [[Blaster Deflection]]) is played slightly later, after that target is chosen.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Sniper (GEMP ID 2_139, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab): the two weapon-selection and retargeting rulings. These interpret the control-phase weapon-firing action also present on the original printing, not later wording changes. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 153, likewise distinguishes the Sniper Interrupt from the weapon targeting a character. Preserved data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Sniper Scomp: Sniper].</ref>
* [[I Have A Bad Feeling About This]] may retarget to a different weapon that can fire, but cannot choose a new target to fire at (because no target to fire at has been selected yet).
